intro: Attention over token vectors needs a way to distinguish where those tokens occur. Build deterministic signals at several frequencies.
task: Return sinusoidal positional encodings with sine in even dimensions and cosine in the following odd dimensions.
requirements: length is a positive integer. dimensions is a positive even integer. Booleans are invalid.
Positions start at zero. A dimension pair 2i and 2i+1 shares frequency 10000**(-2i/dimensions).
Return a NumPy array of shape (length, dimensions). Use radians and a base of 10000.
Do not modify inputs. Raise ValueError for the invalid shapes, ranges, or non-finite numeric inputs described above. Numerical checks use moderate finite values unless stated otherwise.

examples.name: Position zero
examples.output:
[[0, 1, 0, 1]]
(Numeric values rounded to 8 decimal places where needed.)

examples.name: One frequency pair
examples.output:
[[0.0, 1.0], [0.84147098, 0.54030231]]
(Numeric values rounded to 8 decimal places where needed.)

examples.name: Two frequencies
examples.output:
[[0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 1.0],
 [0.84147098, 0.54030231, 0.00999983, 0.99995]]
(Numeric values rounded to 8 decimal places where needed.)

hints.title: Choose the representation
hints.body: Build a position column and a vector of frequencies for indices 0,2,4,….

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: Assign sine to columns 0::2 and cosine to columns 1::2.

explanation: Every position receives a vector of oscillations at several frequencies. Fast channels distinguish nearby positions while slow channels change over a wider span.
Each sine/cosine pair uses the same angle. At position zero the sine channels are zero and cosine channels are one, providing a useful convention check.
Plot one fast pair and one slow pair over a longer sequence. Explain why repeating one frequency across all channels would provide less varied positional structure.
